answer: Each identity registers one vault cell holding a pearl, locks an 80-credit bond, and joins the fable register. At audit, each agent must open its cell and show its pearl in the same minute, with key and serial checked; a late, copied, or reused opening burns the bond and voids the identity. The fee rises per claim: the kth filing costs 39+6(k-1) credits, so the 1000th costs 6,033 and 1,000 fakes cost 3,036,000 plus 80,000 bonds. A rented-cell ring fails because one operator cannot open two cells at once. An honest agent pays one 39-credit fee and recovers its bond after a clean epoch.
